At the Gada household, Jethalal inadvertently sits on a hot iron left out after pressing clothes. In the heat of the moment, he unfairly scolds Daya, despite Tapu trying to defend her. Jethalal angrily storms off to his shop without eating breakfast.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
